common.title: Uma-connect

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.goal: Fill the 3×3 grid with Umamusume trainees.

rule.pick: Tap an empty cell and search for a trainee.
rule.match: The trainee must match both the row category and the column category.
rule.guesses: You have 9 guesses in total. Wrong guesses still use one up.
rule.noReuse: Each trainee version can only be used once per grid.
rule.versions: Alternate outfits are separate answers with their own aptitudes, e.g. "Special Week" and "Special Week · Summer".
rule.rules: Tap a category to read its exact rule.
rule.reset: A new grid is published every day at 00:00 UTC.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.deviceOnly: Statistics are stored only on this device.
stats.synced: Statistics are saved to your account.

practice.title: Practice
practice.subtitle: Unlimited grids. They don't affect your daily progress or statistics.
practice.noGrid: Couldn't build a grid for this seed. Try a new grid.

about.title: About Uma-connect
about.intro: Uma-connect is a daily grid trivia game about Umamusume: Pretty Derby, inspired by PokeDoku and Immaculate Grid.
about.disclaimer: Uma-connect is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cygames, Inc. Umamusume: Pretty Derby names, images, and materials are trademarks and copyrights of Cygames, Inc. Real-horse names belong to their respective owners.
about.guidelines: Uma-connect is free, has no ads, and follows the official
about.guidelinesLink: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Fan-Created Content Guidelines.

gametora.name: GameTora
gametora.use: trainee versions, aptitudes, birthdays, and dorms.

umamusuWiki.name: Umamusume Wiki (umamusu.wiki, CC BY-SA)
umamusuWiki.use: real-horse coat, sire line, and race wins.

source.images: Trainee chibi images are game assets © Cygames, Inc.

about.privacy: You can play without an account; your progress and statistics then stay only in your browser.
about.privacyAccount: If you sign in, we store your email address, a public display name, and your daily games (guesses, scores, and times) so your progress syncs across devices and you can appear on leaderboards. Practice games always stay on your device.
about.privacyGuest: When you finish a daily grid as a guest, your answers may be sent anonymously (no email or account) to calculate how rare each answer is.
about.privacyControl: You can download your data, hide yourself from leaderboards, or permanently delete your account at any time on the Account page. Deletion is immediate; only anonymous answer counts used for rarity remain.
about.privacyAge: Accounts are intended for players aged 13 or older. Account data is hosted by Supabase.

auth.title: Sign in to Uma-connect
auth.intro: Save your progress and continue on any device. We'll email you a one-time sign-in link; no password needed.
auth.checkEmailHint: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it in this browser to finish signing in.
auth.privacyNote: Your games played on this device so far will be added to your account.

error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in emails. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
error.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. You can keep playing as a guest.

callbackError.title: This sign-in link didn't work
callbackError.body: It may have expired, been used already, or been opened in a different browser than the one you requested it from. Request a new link from the same browser.

sync.otherDeviceKept: You played today's grid on another device first, so that game was kept and the one on this device was discarded.

rules.daily: Highest score, then lowest rarity score, then earliest finish.
rules.week: Total score, then lowest total rarity, then more games played.
rules.month: Total score, then lowest total rarity, then more games played.
rules.all: Total score, then more perfect grids, then earliest account.
